paite: Elihu mahin a gen jela, huchiin a chi a:
english: Elihu also continued, and said,

paite: Honna thuakzou zek inla, huan ka hon ensak ding; Pathian sikin lah banghiam khat gending ka nei ngala.
english: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.

paite: Gamla akipan ka theihna kon la dinga, huan diktatna kei Bawlpa tungah ka nga ding hi.
english: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

paite: Diktakin ka thute lah juau ahi ngal keia: hoihkim khat lah ka kiangah a om hi.
english: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

paite: Ngaiin, Pathianin thil a hihtheia, kuamah a musit kei: theihsiamna hatna ah thil a hihthei hi.
english: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.

paite: Gilou hinna a hawi keia: himahleh gimthuakte kiangah a dikna uh a pia hi.
english: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives to the afflicted their right.

paite: Mi diktat akipan a mit a la kik keia: himahleh laltutphah tunga kumpipa toh amau khantawnin a koiha, huchiin hihletin a om uhi.
english: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

paite: Huan sikkhautea gaka a om ua, gimthuakna guitea laka a om uleh;
english: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,

paite: Huchiin a thilhih uh amau a ensaka, huan a tatlekna uh, huchia kisatheitaka a na omna uh.
english: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

paite: Thuhilhna lamah a bil uh leng a honsaka, thulimlouhna akipan kik dingin thu a pia hi.
english: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.

paite: Amah thu a ngaihkhiak ua, a na a sep uh leh, a nite uh hausaknain a hihbei ding ua, a kumte uh kipahnain.
english: If they listen and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

paite: Himahleh a ngaihkhiak kei ua leh, namsauin a mangthang ding ua, huan theihna beiin a si ding uh.
english: But if they don’t listen, they shall perish by the sword; they shall die without knowledge.

paite: Himahleh amau lungtanga pathianilimsaklouhnaten hehna a khol khawm uhi: amau a hen laiin panpih deihin a kikou kei uh.
english: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.

paite: Tuailaiin a si ua, siangloute lakah a hinna uh a mangthang hi.
english: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.

paite: A gimthuaknain gimthuakte a suaktasaka, nuaisiah na ah a bil uh a honsak hi.
english: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.

paite: A hi, gakchihna om louhna mun, mun lian lamah dahna akipan nang a honpi mang ta ding a; huan na donkan tunga kilui thaunain a dimta ding hi.
english: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a broad place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

paite: Himahleh giloute vaihawmnain na dima: vaihawmna leh diktatnain nang nang a honlen hi.
english: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

paite: Thangpaihna a om jiakin, pilvangin huchilouin jaw na kichinnain nang a honpi mangkha ding hi; tatna letnain leng nang honpialsak sam kei hen.
english: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

paite: Dahna a na om louhna dingin, na hauhsaknate a hun diam, ahihkeileh na hatna thilhihtheihna tengteng?
english: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

paite: Mite tengteng a mun ua sat khiaka a om lai un, jan deih ken.
english: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.

paite: Pilvangin, gilou limsak ken: gimthuakna sangin hiai lah na telta ngala.
english: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

paite: Ngaiin, Pathianin a thilhihtheihnain sangtakin a hih: amah bang sinsakmi kua ahia?
english: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

paite: Kuan amah a lampi thu a piaa? ahihkeileh, kuan, Diklouhna na bawlta, a chi thei dia?
english: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness?’

paite: Miten la a asak uh, a thilhih hihlian dingin theigige in.
english: “Remember that you magnify his work, whereof men have sung.

paite: Huaiah mite tengteng a en ua; huai mihing in gamla pi ah a mu hi.
english: All men have looked thereon. Man sees it afar off.

paite: Ngaiin, Pathian a liana, amah I theikei uh: a kumte zah zontheih ahi kei.
english: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.

paite: Tui takte aman a tawi khin ngala, huai a tuihu akipan vuah a ju:
english: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,

paite: Huai vanten a sungkhe suk ua, tampipiin mihing tungah a tak.
english: Which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.

paite: A hi, meipi kiphahte, a in vanpigingte kuamahmahin a theisiam dia?
english: Yes, can any understand the spreading of the clouds, and the thunderings of his pavilion?

paite: Ngaiin, a kimah a khovak a jaka: huan tuipi nuai a tuam hi.
english: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.

paite: Hiaitein lah mite a vaihawmsak ngala; an tampi a pia hi.
english: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.

paite: Khophiain a khutte a tuama; huan chiamtehna khoh dingin thu a pia hi.Huai husain a tungtang thu a gena, ganhonten leng hongkuan tou huihpi tungtang thu.
english: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.

paite: Huai husain a tungtang thu a gena, ganhonten leng hongkuan tou huihpi tungtang thu.
english: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also concerning the storm that comes up.
